options: A rock that contains a mineral in enough quantity to be mined profitably
optionsAf: ’n Rots wat ’n mineraal in genoeg hoeveelheid bevat om winsgewend ontgin te word
items.explain: An ore is a mineral-rich rock from which a metal can be extracted economically.
items.explainAf: ŉ Erts is ’n mineraalryke rots waaruit ’n metaal ekonomies onttrek kan word.

items.q: Why are minerals a non-renewable resource?
options: They take millions of years to form and cannot be replaced on human timescales
optionsAf: Hulle neem miljoene jare om te vorm en kan nie op menslike tydskale vervang word nie
items.explain: Mineral deposits form over geological time, so once mined they are effectively used up.
items.explainAf: Mineraalafsettings vorm oor geologiese tyd, so as hulle ontgin is, is hulle feitlik op.

items.q: Which is a metal ore found in South Africa?
items.qAf: Watter is ’n metaalerts wat in Suid-Afrika gevind word?
items.explain: Iron ore is mined in South Africa; coal is a fuel and diamond is a gem, not a metal ore.
items.explainAf: Ystererts word in Suid-Afrika ontgin; steenkool is ’n brandstof en diamant is ’n edelsteen, nie ’n metaalerts nie.

items.q: What is one environmental effect of open-cast mining?
items.qAf: Wat is een omgewingsimpak van oopmyn-ontginning?
options: It destroys habitats and leaves scars on the land
optionsAf: Dit vernietig habitatte en laat letsels op die land
items.explain: Open-cast mining removes vegetation and soil, and can pollute water with acidic runoff.
items.explainAf: Oopmyn-ontginning verwyder plantegroei en grond, en kan water besoedel met suur afloop.

items.q: Acid mine drainage can pollute rivers. What causes the acid?
items.qAf: Suur mynafloop kan riviere besoedel. Wat veroorsaak die suur?
options: Sulfide minerals reacting with air and water
optionsAf: Sulfiedminerale wat met lug en water reageer
Plante wat naby die myn groei
items.explain: Exposed sulfide minerals react with oxygen and water to form sulfuric acid.
items.explainAf: Blootgestelde sulfiedminerale reageer met suurstof en water om swaelsuur te vorm.

items.q: Which practice reduces the impact of mining on land?
items.qAf: Watter praktyk verminder die impak van mynbou op grond?
optionsAf: Bogrond verwyder en dit laat lê
items.explain: Rehabilitation replants and reshapes the land, reducing lasting damage.
items.explainAf: Rehabilitasie herplant en vorm die grond, en verminder blywende skade.
